verdict.rationale: Turso's docs include a first-party Next.js framework guide, and it claims SQLite compatibility with SDKs in TypeScript, Python, Rust and Go. That gives some documented framework integration, but nothing in the pack covers the ORMs or frameworks the story names. missing for 10: documented Prisma, Drizzle, Django and Rails guides or adapters, evidence of out-of-the-box ORM compatibility, independent or hands-on corroboration of ORM/framework integration.

support.subject: As a developer, the database works out of the box with my ORM and framework (Prisma, Drizzle, Django, Rails) with documented guides

citations.quote: Set up Turso in your Next.js project in minutes.
SQLite-compatible. SDKs in TypeScript, Python, Rust, and Go.
